name: Themis
subtitle: Themis, Weaver of Fate
description: All who have the good fortune to stand before Themis will be awed by her presence. Her every word carries the weight of universal law, compelling her allies to victory and her foes to ruin. She excels at controlling the pace of battle through manipulating turn order and buffing her allies’ damage through a mixture of her own abilities and her trusty Hammer’s effects.
lore: There are few Beings in the known history of the Cosmos who have held the title and office of Judge. These arbiters of justice and truth hold the power to shape the very fabric of existence, for they alone can define the deepest, most fundamental form of truth. So it is with Themis, the Judge of Olympus. From the earliest days of Zeus’ reign, Themis has been at his side, helping him to shape Olympus and bring Justice and Order to the fledgling Pantheons. She oversaw the passage of laws, the punishment of the wicked, and the protection of the innocent. So respected was she that the very fabric of Olympus would bend to her will. She, with her gavel and scales, brought Order to Chaos, Time to Eternity, and Justice to Injustice itself. So too was it Themis who decreed the foundations of their laws that they must protect all life. When Zeus' pride pushed him to condemn humanity after their perceived betrayal, Themis stood against him. For the first time, her laws and his desires crossed. In that moment, she learned that even her power had limits. Though Zeus eventually relented, the damage had been done. Themis left Olympus, and though she has not abandoned Her duties, she has become a wanderer. Even with the freedom to go where she pleases, she searches still for a truth that goes beyond even her own understanding. Even as she searches, Themis’ heart remains in Olympus, for it is her home, and it is in her nature to protect it. She watches over it still, and her resolve has never been stronger. Until she can finally return home, wielding a truth that will force Zeus himself to bow, she will continue to search for the perfect form of justice, so that all life may one day be protected.

leader_bonus.text: All allies gain 20 Speed and 20% Resistance.

divinity_generator: When an ally takes an extra turn, gain 1 Divinity. When an ally takes a turn, if they are buffed by Divine Intervention, gain 1 Divinity.

skills.name: Hammer of Justice
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy. If the target is a Chaos hero, also attack all other enemies with 50% damage.
skills.awakening_bonus: Grants target 1 stack of Defense Down I for 2 turns.

skills.name: Divine Intervention
skills.description: Grant an ally Divine Intervention for 2 turns and 1 extra turn. Divine Intervention: Grants 20% Attack and 10% Speed.
skills.awakening_bonus: Grants Divine Intervention to 1 other random ally.

skills.name: All-Seeing Eye
skills.description: When an ally takes an extra turn, Themis gains 50 Speed until her next turn.

skills.name: Universal Law
skills.description: Attack all enemies. For each Chaos hero hit, extend all buffs on allies by 1 turn. This skill cannot be counterattacked. Universal Law ignores 20% of the target's Defense.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also removes 1 buff from each enemy.

imprint_passive: While Themis is alive, all allies gain 5 Speed and 10% Resistance.
